description: List all URL forwarding rules configured for a domain. Each entry includes its `id` (used by `delete_url_forward`), the source subdomain, the destination URL, the redirect `type` (permanent/temporary/masked), the exact `redirectType` code (301/302/307/masked — distinguishes 302 from 307), and whether the request path and wildcards are forwarded.
name: list_url_forwards
title: List URL Forwards
